name: Proterial Cable America, Inc.
old_description: At Proterial Cable America, we’ve been at the forefront of progress since 1986, manufacturing innovative materials and components for advanced communication networks, life-saving medical equipment, forward-thinking automotive technologies, and defense contracting solutions.
about:
Proterial Cable America, Inc. traces its roots to 1986 when Hitachi Cable America established a manufacturing facility in Manchester, New Hampshire. The company, now a subsidiary of Proterial Ltd. (formerly Hitachi Metals), rebranded to its current name as part of a global corporate identity shift. From its New Hampshire headquarters, the business has expanded to eight manufacturing sites worldwide, including locations in Indiana, Mexico, Rhode Island, and Connecticut.

The company operates through three divisions. The Performance Cable Systems & Materials Division produces copper and fiber optic communication cables and assemblies supporting Ethernet, video, Power over Ethernet, HDMI, and InfiniBand applications. The Automotive Products Division supplies original equipment manufacturers and Tier 1 suppliers with power cable harnesses for electric and hybrid vehicles, brake hoses, electronic parking brake harnesses, wheel speed sensors, and torque sensors. The High Performance Medical Solutions Division, certified to ISO 13485:2016, provides complex catheter tubing, braided and high-pressure braided tubing, secondary operations, medical machining, fabrication, 3D additive manufacturing, cable assemblies, and full device assembly for products such as PICC catheters, introducer sheaths, fluid transport tubing, ultrasound devices, endoscopic camera catheters, and advanced diagnostic or surgical catheters. The combined facilities offer both high-volume production and rapid prototyping capabilities.

Proterial Cable America serves four primary sectors: data communications OEMs requiring high-performance connectivity; medical device OEMs needing precision extrusion and assembly; automotive OEMs and major Tier 1s sourcing brake and sensor systems; and defense contractors requiring ITAR-compliant manufacturing. Customers include manufacturers of networking equipment, minimally invasive surgical devices, electric vehicle platforms, and military communication systems.

The company emphasizes a "Professional, Proactive, Progressive" approach, highlighting long-term customer relationships, rigorous quality control under ISO 9001:2015, and a safety-first culture across all divisions. Its engineering team of 43 specialists works to integrate design, compliance, and manufacturing to accelerate customer innovation.
